members.name: Witwe Halloran
members.description: an old herbalist widow in a moss-green shawl over a dark green dress, white hair in a loose bun, bundles of dried herbs hanging from her belt, soil under her nails, a kind but calculating smile

members.name: Doktor Pellam Rusk
members.description: a thin middle-aged man in a dark grey-blue frock coat, a grey cravat, slicked brown hair, small round tinted spectacles, a leather case of vials, nervous long fingers

members.name: Mags Oddny
members.description: a stocky woman in a patched brown oilskin coat and waders, rust-red hair under a knit cap, a teal scarf, a long hooked pole and a sack of things fished out of the canals

members.name: Der stumme Ferro
members.description: a tall gaunt silent man in a dark grey coat and a rubber apron, black hair cut short, pale skin, a cloth over his mouth and nose, gentle sad eyes, hands always folded

members.name: Professor Edmund Sallow
members.description: an elderly scholar in a worn brown tweed coat with a dark red scarf, grey-white hair and mutton chops, chalk dust on his sleeves, a stack of papers under one arm, a proud bitter look

members.name: Schwester Ines Corve
members.description: a woman in her forties in a dark blue-grey dress with a white starched collar and a plain white coif, dark hair underneath, a rosary of plain wooden beads without a symbol, a steady cool gaze

members.name: Lord Tobiah Ashdown
members.description: a young lord in his twenties in a wine-red velvet coat and a gold cravat, golden-blond curls, a signet ring, a slightly frayed cuff, a charming smile with worry behind it

members.name: Kit Pemberley
members.description: a young woman clerk in a slate-blue jacket and skirt, auburn hair in a practical knot, ink-stained fingers, a pencil behind her ear, a ledger clutched to her chest, sharp curious eyes

members.name: Rattenkönigin Dot
members.description: a small wiry woman in a brown leather coat with many pockets, grey-brown hair in a messy braid, an ochre scarf, two rats on her shoulders and one peeking from a pocket, a toothy grin

members.name: Hakenhand Brann
members.description: a scarred broad man in a dusty grey-brown coat, dark beard, a rust-brown scarf, an iron hook instead of his left hand, crater glass shards on a cord around his neck

members.name: Die Cobb-Zwillinge
members.description: two identical skinny young men with copper-red hair sharing one oversized dark teal greatcoat (one head out of the collar, one arm out of each sleeve belonging to a different twin), a mustard scarf wrapped around both, mischievous identical grins; in the walk sheet they move as one awkward wide figure

members.name: Old Sorrel
members.description: an ancient bent woman in a dark maroon shawl and layers of black cloth, wispy white hair, a necklace of small bones, a tray of bones and teeth on a strap, sharp black eyes

members.name: Bruder Docht
members.description: a hunched man in a soot-black smock and hood, wax drips on his sleeves, a bundle of unlit candles on his back, a burned thumb, a quiet watchful face lit only by a peat ember

members.name: Die blinde Mareike
members.description: a thin woman in a dark violet-grey dress and shawl, grey hair loose, a pale cloth tied over empty eye sockets, her head tilted as if listening, long fingers touching the air

members.name: Fenn der Torfstecher
members.description: a weathered marsh worker in a peat-brown smock and cap, a muddy beard, a short peat spade on his shoulder, heavy boots, a slow wary nod

members.name: Bruder Gischt
members.description: a broad fisherman in a navy sea jacket and a pale blue-grey scarf, brown hair and stubble, salt in his eyebrows, a coil of line over his shoulder, a loud laugh

members.name: Mutter Lake
members.description: an old woman in a grey knitted shawl over a grey-green dress, grey hair under a kerchief, a net draped over her lap and a net needle in hand, patient knowing eyes

members.name: Der Bootsjunge Tam
members.description: a cheeky boy of about twelve with ginger hair under a too-big cap, a brown jacket and a blue neckerchief, bare feet, a message tube on a string, always running

STYLE GUIDE (apply to every asset):
Top-down 3/4 perspective pixel art for a 2D mystery/investigation game, in the readable, cozy-clean style of classic farming/life-sim pixel games, but dark and atmospheric.

Avoid saturated primaries and pure black/white.
Lighting: flat base colors with 2-3 shade steps; light from top-left. Do not bake night darkness into sprites (the engine adds lighting).
Mood: melancholic, mysterious, slightly unsettling, never gory.
Output: transparent background (PNG with alpha) unless stated otherwise, orthographic, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark, no signature.

Use the attached sprites as strict style reference: same palette, outline color, pixel density, proportions and light direction.
